questions.question: How do you transition from an individual contributor (IC) to a team manager?
questions.ideal_answer: Shift focus from personal output to empowering the team and driving collective success. Delegate effectively, establish regular 1-on-1s, provide constructive feedback, build trust, and advocate for team members' career development while stepping back from micromanaging code.
key_points: Shifts mindset from individual execution to team enablement
Focuses on career growth, mentoring, and psychological safety
